market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $40,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC's 2026 low is ~$60K (Feb). Currently ~$77K. To touch $40K requires ~48% drop in 8 months — equivalent to a major bear-market cycle low. Historical drawdowns of that magnitude in 8 months are rare absent extreme macro shock. Estimate ~5-8%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black swan macro/regulatory event could trigger such a drop; currently low probability.
